status: frozen after the SmolVLM2 seed-0 no-entropy result and before any seed-1/2 confirmation training
purpose: Confirm that removing the uniform-routing reward yields a repeatable Full RSM-AttnRes improvement on SmolVLM2-2.2B rather than a favorable seed-0 fluctuation.

seed0_evidence_before_freeze.interpretation: The seed-0 cell clears every frozen Amendment-007 continuation gate. The matched comparison isolates the interaction between native residual-strength modulation and unconstrained source specialization.

requirements: The three-seed mean RSM macro exceeds the three-seed mean matched Full AttnRes macro by at least 0.15 percentage points.
The three-seed mean RSM macro exceeds Frozen Base.
At least two of three paired seeds have positive RSM-minus-Full deltas.
acceptance_gate.failure_policy: Retain seed-0 as exploratory evidence only; do not replace the paper result and do not tune another SmolVLM2 recipe.
